description: A body-top `const` bound to an interpolated template renders its value (not an empty element).
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet: a <program> body-top run is code, checked exactly as inside `${ … }`. A `const` bound to an interpolated template literal holds the template's value; `${name}` in markup renders that value (§4.18.4 / §7). S441 round 4 (#4): the constant folder used to fold an interpolated template to "" — the page rendered an empty element with no binding.
